customManagers.description: Track container image pins declared as *_image vars in Ansible role defaults. Pins are the exception here (the repo defaults to :latest), so anything matching this is deliberate and wants a review PR when upstream moves.
Container image pins in the cluster manifests (the OpenObserve schema pin moved here with P4b, ADR 0036).

packageRules.description: OpenObserve is pinned to an arch-suffixed release candidate because the metadata DB is on schema 46 and the latest tag regressed to a schema-45 build. Default docker versioning cannot order 'v0.92.0-rc2-amd64', so parse it explicitly: this makes v0.92.0-amd64 (final) sort above the rc and open the unpin PR.
